security_audit.summary: The backticks mark Markdown references, and the alleged reconnaissance is billing documentation. The setup passes the API key to an external server process and directs users to a separate domain for key issuance and billing. The workflow installs an external package globally and recommends billable task creation without an explicit confirmation step.

remediation.issue: Global installation of an external MCP server
remediation.suggestion: Publish a verified package digest, review dependency and lifecycle scripts, and document a user-approved installation in an isolated environment.

remediation.issue: API key passed to the external MCP process
remediation.suggestion: Pass only a dedicated, revocable key through the client secret store to a reviewed server. Document the authorized API hosts and keep the key out of logs.

remediation.issue: Separate domain for key issuance and billing
remediation.suggestion: Link to the billing portal from the primary PipiAds site and document the domain relationship. Tell users to verify the destination before entering payment details.

remediation.issue: Billable task creation without explicit approval
remediation.suggestion: Show the exact advertiser, task count, credit cost, and refund policy before requesting approval. Check for existing tasks before retrying an uncertain request.

content.value_statement: One-time ad searches can miss changes in what competitors advertise over time. Use PipiAds monitoring tasks to review ads, products, landing pages, and copy from selected Facebook advertisers.
actual_capabilities: Find Facebook advertisers by name and create, list, inspect, or cancel monitoring tasks.
Review dashboard, real-time, and daily monitoring overviews and ad count statistics.
Inspect monitored ads and review observed products and landing pages.
Identify the most-used and longest-running ad copy in monitoring results.
Organize tasks into groups and review or update notification settings.
limitations: Requires the PipiAds MCP server and a PipiAds API key. The skill does not supply monitoring data without that connection.
Focuses on monitored Facebook advertisers, not TikTok, one-time ad library discovery, or product research outside those advertisers.
Each successful task creation costs one credit. Cancellation does not refund credits.
Task creation accepts one target list with 1 to 50 targets.

use_cases.title: Find the right competitor account
use_cases.description: Search for a competitor by name and verify the Facebook page before deciding whether to spend a credit on monitoring.

use_cases.title: Review competitor product activity
use_cases.description: See which products and landing pages have appeared recently in an existing advertiser monitor.

use_cases.title: Compare advertising messages
use_cases.description: Use copy frequency and run length to compare messages and identify themes for your own creative research.

prompt_templates.title: Find an advertiser
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: identify a Facebook page without spending credits on a monitor.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Facebook advertisers that match [advertiser name]. Show the matching page names and available identifiers. Do not create a monitoring task.

prompt_templates.title: Review a daily overview
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: check recent activity in a monitor that already exists.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the latest daily overview for [monitor name]. Summarize the ad count and any newly observed ads. Tell me if the monitor has no data.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a monitoring task
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: verify a target and review the cost before creating a task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify the Facebook page for [advertiser name] and check for an existing monitor. Show the target, credit cost, and refund policy. Wait for my approval before creating a task.

prompt_templates.title: Compare monitored advertisers
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: research creative patterns across two existing monitors.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [monitor A] and [monitor B] using available ad counts, most-used copy, longest-running copy, and landing pages. State the reporting periods and flag any gaps in the comparison.

output_examples.input: Find Northstar Outfitters on Facebook and ask before creating a monitor.
output_examples.output: Illustrative result: Northstar Outfitters is the closest match. Creating one monitor costs one credit, and cancellation will not refund it. No task has been created.

output_examples.input: Review the latest daily overview for the existing Northstar Outfitters monitor.
output_examples.output: Illustrative result: The latest report shows eight monitored ads, including two newly observed ads. Both new ads link to the spring collection page.

best_practices: Verify the package and billing portal through the vendor before installation. Configure your API key through the client secret store.
Check the exact advertiser and existing tasks before approving a billable monitor. Confirm cost and refund terms first.
After a timeout, check whether the task already exists before retrying.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat or share them in monitoring reports.
Do not create a paid task from an ambiguous name match or assume cancellation refunds credits.
Do not interpret frequent or long-running ad copy as proof of sales, profit, or ad effectiveness.

faq.question: What do I need to connect PipiAds?
faq.answer: You need the PipiAds MCP server and a PipiAds API key. The documented npm setup also requires npm.

faq.question: What does a monitoring task cost?
faq.answer: Each successful creation costs one credit, and cancellation does not refund it. The skill documents monitoring reads and settings as free.

faq.question: How many targets can I include?
faq.answer: Use one target list per creation request. The documented range is 1 to 50 targets.

faq.question: Can it research TikTok ads or perform one-time Facebook ad discovery?
faq.answer: No. This skill is designed for ongoing Facebook advertiser monitoring, not TikTok research or one-time ad library discovery.

faq.question: What should I do if task creation times out?
faq.answer: Check the existing tasks before retrying. The server may have created the task even though the request timed out.

faq.question: Can I organize monitors and manage notifications?
faq.answer: Yes. You can assign tasks to monitor groups and review or update the notification settings.
